source_coverage.coverage_note: Each validation case records a first-party official URL and company/customer-decision facts. This is a qualitative multi-company validation set, not a statistically representative market sample.

why_not_READY_FOR_RUNTIME_IMPLEMENTATION: The eight-family taxonomy covers all 16 cases without a ninth-family gap, but multiple legitimate family collisions require explicit decision-state boundary rules and a human-review fallback. Numeric weighting precision is not calibrated.
why_not_RESEARCH_REVISION_REQUIRED: No case exposed a missing family; each ambiguity was explainable as a boundary/secondary-influence problem within the existing eight-family system.
saturation_statement: The set was deliberately balanced at two materially different dominant cases per family. The second case in each family changed composition examples and sharpened boundaries but did not create a new family. Further validation should be regression expansion, not broad taxonomy discovery, unless a new sector exposes an unexplainable decision job.
key_findings: Creative Fit and Production Feasibility remain separable in all 16 cases.
All 16 feasibility-only counterfactual perturbations preserve dominant family.
Every family supports materially different composition grammar across its two cases; family-to-layout mapping is invalid.
The strongest runtime need is collision handling, not additional families.
Current Issue #47 contract is structurally sound but is not yet a true inference selector because dominant_family is supplied before select_family validation.
Secondary influence is normal and should be first-class in runtime output.
No numeric family probability or Template Resemblance threshold is justified.
remaining_uncertainty: The 0..1 Creative Fit annotations are expert ordinal judgments, not learned/calibrated weights.
Conversion lift from one valid family versus another acceptable alternative has not been experimentally measured.
Novel sectors outside Beauty/Wellness and directly adjacent contexts may expose new collisions or taxonomy gaps.
Some cases require human interpretation of customer readiness or whether locality/provenance is truly decision-relevant.
Selector implementation must be followed by automated multi-company regression and later Production outcome validation.
routing: Riko Issue #49 complete -> Sarah research/contract audit -> if PASS, Rin implements runtime selector + automated multi-company regression. No Nagi rebuild in this task.
